sources.description: 启用的数据源及优先顺序；合并同一地震时排在前面的数据源提供地点文字，某个数据源失败时由其余数据源兜底

en.description: Enabled data sources in priority order. The first source supplies location text when merging the same earthquake; other sources cover a failed source.

cencUrls.description: CENC 地震目录地址，按顺序尝试（首个为主源，其余为备用镜像）；仅支持 HTTPS，最多 5 个

en.description: CENC catalog URLs, tried in order (primary followed by mirrors). HTTPS only, up to 5 URLs.

usgsFeed.description: USGS GeoJSON 汇总源名称（震级下限_时间范围）

pollCron.description: 订阅轮询频率（6 段 Cron：秒 分 时 日 月 周）

en.description: Subscription polling schedule (6-field cron: second, minute, hour, day, month, weekday).

timezone.description: 显示发震时刻使用的 IANA 时区

en.description: IANA timezone used to display earthquake times.

requestTimeoutMs.description: 单次 HTTP 请求超时（毫秒）

maxRetries.description: 网络错误、超时、429 与 5xx 的重试次数（不含首次请求）

en.description: Retries for network errors, timeouts, HTTP 429 and 5xx, excluding the initial request.

retryBaseDelayMs.description: 指数退避的首次等待（毫秒），每次重试翻倍并加入随机抖动

en.description: Initial exponential-backoff delay in milliseconds; doubles for each retry with random jitter.

retryMaxDelayMs.description: 单次退避或 Retry-After 等待上限（毫秒）；服务端要求更久时本轮放弃并冷却该数据源

en.description: Maximum backoff or Retry-After wait in milliseconds. Longer server waits abandon this round and cool down the source.

defaultMinMagnitude.description: 订阅未指定震级时使用的最小震级

en.description: Minimum magnitude for subscriptions that do not specify one.

queryMinMagnitude.description: 「地震」查询未指定震级时使用的最小震级

en.description: Minimum magnitude for earthquake queries that do not specify one.
Default number of earthquake query results.

maxEventAgeMinutes.description: 只推送发震时间在此分钟数以内的地震，避免推送迟到或重放的旧事件

en.description: Only notify about earthquakes from the last specified number of minutes, avoiding delayed or replayed old events.

pushLimit.description: 每个会话在一个限流窗口内最多推送的消息数

en.description: Maximum notification messages per conversation in one rate-limit window.

pushWindowMinutes.description: 推送限流窗口长度（分钟）

maxEventsPerMessage.description: 单条推送消息最多列出的地震数，其余以数量概括

en.description: Maximum earthquakes listed in one notification; the remainder is summarized as a count.

maxSubscriptions.description: 本实例所有会话的订阅总数上限（每个会话最多一个订阅）

en.description: Maximum subscriptions across this instance, at most one per conversation.
